latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video JSON AI — Extract Video Data as JSON.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM video files up to 500MB for automated AI-powered extraction of metadata and scene data as structured JSON.
- One-click setup: free token generation and session connection handled automatically.
- Supports developer- and marketer-friendly workflows with cloud GPU processing; JSON output ready in 20–40 seconds for short clips.
- Covers export to MP4 and common formats, batch processing, iterative editing, and real-time job status updates.
- Detailed error handling for uploads, tokens, credits, and rate limits.
